task: Call the run_tests tool exactly once with command='pytest -q test_smoke.py' and setup='pip install pytest'. Then reply with the tool's passed value, its conclusion, and the final line of pytest output. Call no other tool.

function.name: run_tests
function.description: Execute a shell command (pytest, python, linters) in a clean throwaway GitHub Actions container and return its exit status and output. This is the ONLY way to actually run code — you have no shell otherwise, so never claim code works because it looks correct. Commit what you want to test to the sandbox repo FIRST (github_commit, repo='agent-sandbox'), then call this. The sandbox holds no secrets and cannot reach other private repos, so copy in any module under test alongside its tests. Takes 1-3 minutes.

setup.description: Optional command run first, e.g. 'pip install pytest httpx'

timeout_sec.description: Max seconds to wait for completion (default 300, max 900)
